notes: Original starter content for the complete final first implementation. This file does not depend on any older package.
No lyrics, recordings, external music API or runtime AI are included.
Read CODEX_FULL_IMPLEMENTATION_PROMPT.md for authoritative rules. Valid room settings override centralized defaults; individual cards must not override the rules.
Secret answer allocations, teammate guesses and private director lines require role-scoped server payloads.
Room prompt language stays fixed during scored rounds. Live Mandarin/Taiwanese director commands change only the current scene performance language.
Story-song requests are supplied by the opposing team during play, with replacement, singer self-selection and pass paths. Do not add a prescribed song list.
No private story transcripts or cross-session personal profiles are included or required.
